title: Colt Shelby for Arkansas
description: "If you remember where you came from, it will always inform where you wanna go. I love this state and this way of life and that is what I am fighting for in this race for Governor. I hope you will join me." – Colt Shelby
transcript: [music] >> My name is Colt Shelby. I grew up inCecil, Arkansas. I'm the son of Rodney and Lisa Shelby, and I'm proud to be asixth-generation member of Franklin County and this community.>> [music]>> After high school, I went to work on drilling rigs and roughnecking all overArkansas. For the past 20 years, I worked in the oil and gas industry.[music] I've done it all from fixing busted rigs to manage a million-dollarcontracts. I've built a life I could be proud of, and I want a state we can allbe proud of. I have attended Cecil Methodist Churchfor over 30 years. It's where I was raised, where my children are beingraised, and where I'm reminded every week what this is really all about. Myfaith, my family, my neighbors, that's what we're fighting for. I'm ColtShelby, [music] and I hope you approve this message.
